            About PokéRoulette

            ◉PokéRoulette WheelSpin, search and discover Pokémon.

            Tap the Poké Ball or swipe to spin; search by Pokémon name or Pokédex number. Explore evolutions, card artwork, previews and sharing. Tap × to clear a search.

            Green counts: loaded / saved. Yellow counts: partial / loading. Pokémon data: PokéAPI; card catalogue and imagery: TCGdex, supplementary card APIs and verified manual references.

            ▤Collection & SetsTrack cards, variants and set progress.

            Track cards in Dex or Sets. Green = base Standard / Holo; yellow = any Reverse; blue = other printings. Split ticks show individual selected versions, including matching colours.

            Add All selects eligible base prints; Remove All clears a set. Search or filter collections; tap × to clear. Collection saves locally; sign in through Profile to sync across devices.

            ⚔BattleBattle Pokémon in 1v1, 3v3 or 6v6.

            Choose or randomise teams for 1v1, 3v3 or 6v6. ▶ normal, ▶▶ 2×, END finishes. Special is manually queued for your team with a 10-second recharge.

            Potions restore 25% max HP at ≤50% HP; 1 / 2 / 3 potions for 1v1 / 3v3 / 6v6. Opponent specials and potions are automatic.

            £Prices & Card DataUnderstand values, sources and updates.

            GBP estimates prioritise Cardmarket Trend, then TCGplayer Market and Cardmarket AVG when available. Missing quotes display N/A; source dates reflect supplied pricing data. Prices update via the existing daily GitHub workflow.

            ⓘLegal & App DetailsCredits, licensing and app information.

            Unofficial, free, non-commercial fan app; not endorsed by Nintendo or The Pokémon Company. Pokémon names, artwork and trademarks belong to their respective rights holders. Prices are estimates, not guaranteed sale values.
